title: Use case 3 — AI review queue (vague opener / discovery)
prompt: Our support bot writes reply drafts and right now they just… send. I want a human checkpoint in between. Can you build something for that?

conversationScript.content: Reviewers need the draft text, which ticket it's for, and the model's confidence. Drafts come from GET /api/drafts, single one is GET /api/drafts/{draftId}.
Approving is POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/approve, rejecting is POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/reject. After either one, back to the list.
List response uses {items: [...]} envelope. Approve and reject are buttons on the detail screen, not on rows. Add a status filter on the inbox.
